Drift.description: The result of a drift detection.

EnvironmentName.description:
An Environment's name, unique across declared Environments and all
template instances because leases, run refs, and keep refs are named
after it. A Kubernetes DNS label.

ExecutionKey.description:
A digest of everything that decides what a unit's execution does:
`sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits.

Uid.description:
The UUIDv7 of one incarnation of a unit. It fences every receipt,
checkpoint, and deletion.

UnitIdentity.description: A unit's identity in state documents.

apiVersion.description:
The unit's kind; empty only in a held marker, which `nyl hold` writes
for a unit it never rendered ([`DesiredUnit::held_marker`]).

uid.description: The incarnation; absent for a held unit without one.

UnitName.description:
A unit's literal `metadata.name`, unique per environment across all
unit kinds. A Kubernetes DNS label.

description:
A unit's latest drift detection, `observed/units/<unit>/drift.yaml`:
what `nyl detect-drift` found for the receipt whose execution key it
names. Contract: [Drift](../../../../design/orchestration-core.md#drift).

details.description: Driver-specific details, recorded and shown unchanged.

title: DriftRecord
